text: The series finale: not a victory lap. What Brindlewood's partner claims system actually shipped, and what's honestly still left undone.
Shipped and real: the table, ACL, portal, Flow Designer routing, API, a passing ATF suite, and a caught-and-fixed cross-partner data leak.
Three real gaps: no automated parts-ordering, no audit of other integrations for the same bug class, and internal staff still on list views.
A short, prioritized next-step list -- starting with auditing every other integration for the same pattern Zara found here.
Series complete -- twenty videos, one honest build, start to finish.
